trigger: Mixed-version rollout or rollback-then-forward: a pre-#6096 leader fires an approved schedule ticket without setting consumed_at, then the leader changes and the new binary fires the same ticket again.
summary: Raised independently by architect, security-guardian, sre, docs-writer, consistency-auditor and unhappy-path. A ticket spent by an older binary is not marked consumed, so the new binary can run a second occurrence on one approval. Fixed by the outbox spent-ticket ledger (4161130e2) and upgrade/rollback docs (a7c536d1b).
classification_rationale: Both a missing required upgrade/rollback doc (absence) and a code-side truth gap; recorded as absence per the findings direction. Reporter named is architect; the other five are counted in independent_reporters.

trigger: Enqueue occurrence N with ticket A, the retire of A fails, and the schedule advances through a skip branch in fire() or the tick() catch; ticket A then fires occurrence N+1.
summary: Advance-without-retire lets one approved ticket authorize a second run. Reporter native label MEDIUM; derived band HIGH (I1 with E5), so severity_mapped is BLOCKING. Fixed by the ledger guard in 4161130e2.
classification_rationale: The code treated an unretired ticket as harmless after a skipped advance; the behaviour contradicted the one-approval-one-run guarantee.

trigger: Retire keyed on the schedule only: a stale or paused leader, or an approval landing after the snapshot, settles a ticket for an occurrence that did not decide it.

classification_rationale: A code comment asserted idempotency the code did not provide. severity_mapped is the derived band HIGH of the recorded impact and exposure; severity_native keeps the reporter's own label.
